title: approving the submitted savings account (id 2) writes status stored value 200 (APPROVED)
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture savings-daily-approve-raw.json (approve command acknowledgement, tenant gerege). request.account_status.step="approve" is the lifecycle command the oracle executed on the submitted account (savingsId 2); expect.status_id=200 is changes.status.id of the acknowledgement, the m_savings_account.status_enum stored value Fineract wrote for the approved state. That stored value is NOT the enum's Go declaration ordinal (APPROVED is 200, not 2), so a port that encodes the status enum as an iota silently corrupts status_enum and this vector goes red. Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: The expected status_id cell is transcribed from the committed capture savings-daily-approve-raw.json; capture_case_id names the status code value in the acknowledgement.
